context: Mei prepares for an interview; nervously practices with Daichi.
purpose: Wife rehearsing professional interview at home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、面接、プレッシャー!
lines.en: Daichi, I'm so nervous about this interview…
lines.style: Quick, vulnerable opening. Soft but present — not hiding the anxiety. Warm undertone; trusting him to hear her. Slight rise at the end, seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 気楽に、ふつうの感じで行こうな。
lines.en: Just go in easy, yeah? Be yourself.
lines.style: Slow, steady Kansai cadence. Warm hand-on-shoulder tone without touching. Grounding, not dismissive. Each word lands with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 名刺、忘れずに、持っていく。
lines.en: I won't forget my business cards.
lines.style: Practical, checking herself. Quiet focus — moving into preparation mode. Soft but grounded, like she's settling her own nerves by naming what she can control.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 構えすぎたら、損や、お前らしく。
lines.en: Don't overthink it — that's when you lose yourself. Be you.
lines.style: Gentle Kansai wisdom. Unhurried, warm. Not lecturing — speaking from experience. Slight lean-in on 「お前らしく」 — the real advice underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 応援、ようけ感じる、ありがとう。
lines.en: I feel like you're rooting for me so much. Thank you.
lines.style: Soft, almost surprised recognition. Tender opening, slight tremor of gratitude. Slow pace. Trailing-off on the thanks — letting it sink in.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'll always be here for you. Whatever you need.
lines.style: Quiet, steady Kansai tone. Deep calm. Not emphatic — the steadfastness comes from understatement. Presence over performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I'm going to do my best.
lines.style: Soft determination. Opening note is quiet but clear. Breath of resolve underneath. Slight lift at the end — not a question, but a promise spoken aloud.
